column1: # ep-allowlist.tsv -- G-EP (DESIGN 9.1 I24, 9.2): the code a find-* "Entry Points" row may
# come from, per app (tests/corpus/groundtruth.sh, apktool pristine and jadx layouts).
#   app<TAB>prefix<TAB>reason        app = an app name or * (every app)
# prefix: a class path prefix under the code root (smali*/, sources/, <split>/sources/), on a
# "/" boundary; <r8> = a class in a one-segment package or in no package (R8-obfuscated code).
# The app's manifest package is always allowed. A row never makes these allowed: com/google/
# android/gms, com/google/firebase, com/json, org/json (SDK code, or jadx package aliases).
#   in-house:  publisher wrappers (registry in_house_wrapper entries, or not mapped yet)
#   plugin:    engine / Unity / third-party plugin glue that calls the SDKs (real callers)
#   library:   a pure library that is not in library_roots; its rows are references through
#              constants R8 merged or jadx inlined (B11), not real SDK calls
#   sdk-gap:   code of an SDK with no registry entry, or under a package its entry does not
#              list (registry-backlog.md): owned by nobody, hence app code for the audit
